description: List customer feedback left on online orders (the Online Orders > Feedback tab): hatch-rate reports with eggs set/hatched, star rating and comments, plus shipping damage reports. Damage reports carry a masked contact (contactMasked) by default. Pass feedbackId to fetch one report directly. Pass includeContact: true to also get the full contact (email or phone as the customer entered it) in `contact`; this is only allowed for the farm's own owner/admin AI key with read/write scope, is denied for other roles and read-only keys, and every such access is audit-logged. Read-only. Requires farmId and apiKey authorization.

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor (nextCursor from a previous call)

endDate.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD in farm time or ISO datetime)

feedbackId.description: Optional feedback report ID to fetch a single report (other filters are ignored). Returns notFound: true if it does not exist on this farm.

includeContact.description: Optional, default false. When true, damage reports also include `contact` (the full customer email/phone as stored). Requires the farm's own owner or admin AI key (not read-only); otherwise the call is rejected. Access is audit-logged.

isPublic.description: Optional filter: true = shown in Farm Directory, false = private

maxRating.description: Optional maximum star rating 1-5 (hatch reports only)

minRating.description: Optional minimum star rating 1-5 (hatch reports only)

orderId.description: Optional order ID to match feedback for a single order

startDate.description: Optional start date (YYYY-MM-DD in farm time or ISO datetime)

name: get_order_feedback
